[New City Planning case filing (application, not yet decided)]
Case numbers: TT-32304
Address: 1334 S CENTRAL AVE
Filed: 2026-11-16
Council district: 14
Community plan area: Downtown
Description: (Demo of an (e) building and replace with a paved parking area.) A variance to allow for a proposed frontage 8' ft CMU site wall with 2' ft fencing on top and right-of-way widths to match (e) wall height, and submit for a waiver of dedication.
summary: Application to demolish an existing building at 1334 S Central Ave and pave the site as parking, with a variance for an 8-foot block wall topped by 2 feet of fencing along the frontage, and a waiver of dedication.
